spec.scope: There is one user role and one maintainer role; no accounts or passwords. The program processes third-party files and writes files.

threat.name: formula_injection
threat.description: A journal entry description that starts with = + - or @ and runs a formula in Excel.
threat.control: Write such texts as literal text.

threat.name: huge_file
threat.description: A huge file that exhausts memory.
threat.control: Documented tested size of 100000 rows; no enforced limit.

threat.name: path_overwrite
threat.description: Replacing a user's file by accident.
threat.control: Refuse if the file exists, unless --overwrite is given.

threat.name: data_exfiltration
threat.control: No network call during analyze, verified by a test.

threat.name: secrets_in_repo
threat.description: Keys or real data in the repository.
threat.control: Synthetic data only; review before publishing.

threat.name: supply_chain
threat.control: Minimal dependencies, versions pinned in constraints.txt, PyPI as the only source.

spec.personal_data: The program does not collect or store personal data. Ledger data stays on the user's computer. Legal basis and retention: not applicable, the project does not process the data.
